name: M3_CRS420MI_AddFreeText
description: Add user-defined free text to an existing application message. This operation attaches a short, user-maintained text entry to the message, equivalent to pressing F6 on panel E in Application Message. Open (CRS420). The free text becomes part of the message’s user-defined free-text block and is stored separately from the standard application message text.

inputParameters.name: MLID
inputParameters.description: Unique mail ID of the application message to which the free text will be added.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the application message.

inputParameters.name: TX60
inputParameters.description: User-defined free-text line to add to the application message.
